title: After the Nikkei Shinshun Hai: A Whole New Me ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer gives it her all in the Nikkei Shinshun Hai. Her party attitude and performance takes a firm grip on the hearts of the fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer's next goal is an all-important race to the Mejiro family—the spring Tenno Sho. She trembles with fear and excitement for the unknown.
